summary: Iteration-6 end-to-end verification of the new Edit Employee feature. BACKEND: 39/39 pytest passing (30 pre-existing + 9 new in /app/backend/tests/test_update_employee.py). New tests cover: (1) PATCH /employees/{id} auth → 401 without Bearer; (2) partial update only writes supplied columns; (3) photo_b64 happy path → response photo becomes `data:image/jpeg;base64,…`, DB `face_encoding` is JSON list of 128 floats, follow-up POST /attendance/match on same b64 matches with distance <0.1; (4) `photo: 'file:///…'` → 422 with detail starting 'Local file URIs are not allowed'; (5) black-image `photo_b64` → 422 (quality gate) and DB photo/face_encoding remain NULL; (6a) `project_id: <pid>` creates exactly ONE Allocation row for (employee, project) AND removes any prior allocation for the same employee, status → 'Active'; (6b) `project_id: ''` removes all allocations, status → 'No Allocation'; (7) update without photo/photo_b64 leaves DB `photo` + `face_encoding` untouched; (8) DELETE /employees/{id} now succeeds even with existing AttendanceRecord/SalaryRecord/Allocation rows and none of those child rows are left as orphans. FRONTEND: All 10 required testIDs verified live in the DOM on the new /employees/[id] route (edit-back-button, edit-delete-button, edit-field-name, edit-field-code, edit-open-camera, edit-status-active, edit-status-inactive, edit-status-no-allocation, edit-project-none, edit-save-button; edit-toast fires on save). List-card → detail-edit navigation works: tapping `employee-card-<id>` on /employees pushes to /employees/<id>. Name + Code fields load correctly from getEmployee(). CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG FOUND (not a regression, but a real UX gap in the new screen): the backend `EmployeeOut` Pydantic model (server.py:437-449) only exposes {id, name, name_hi, code, designation, skill, status, photo, primary_mobile, email, project_id, project_name} — it does NOT include gender/marital_status/dob/father_name/nominee/alt_mobile/date_of_joining/date_of_exit/current_address/permanent_address/aadhaar/pan/uan/esi. The new Edit screen (`app/employees/[id].tsx::fromEmployee`) reads all of those fields off the returned Employee, so they all render as blank inputs on the form even when the DB has real values. Verified in prod DB: DHD-2009 'Saqib' has gender='Male', marital_status='Single', dob='07 Sep 2026', father_name='Taj', aadhaar='987654321234', current_address='Jamia', date_of_joining='07 Sep 2026' — none of which render in the Edit form (only Name/Code/Designation/Skill/Status/Project populate). Data itself is safe on Save because form value '' collapses to `undefined` and pydantic exclude_none skips it — the row is not corrupted. But this defeats the whole point of an Edit screen. FIX NEEDED: extend `EmployeeOut` (and TS `Employee` type in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.ts:31-44) with all the extra employee columns, and update employee_to_out() to populate them.

ui_bugs.issue: All fields other than Name/Code/Designation/Skill/Status/Project render blank when opening an existing employee — the GET response never includes gender/marital_status/dob/father_name/nominee/alt_mobile/date_of_joining/date_of_exit/current_address/permanent_address/aadhaar/pan/uan/esi. The DB has these values but EmployeeOut drops them. Users see an empty form and (if they type nothing) preserve the value, but they cannot see or verify what they had. Reference: /app/backend/server.py:437-449 EmployeeOut + /app/backend/server.py:760-765 employee_to_out + /app/frontend/src/lib/api.ts:31-44 Employee type.

integration_issues.issue: EmployeeOut is a strict subset of the underlying columns, so the round-trip loses fields. Fix requires adding fields to Pydantic model + TS type + employee_to_out().

issues: Carry-over pre-existing web-only cosmetic warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow); Animated useNativeDriver JS fallback; pointerEvents-as-prop deprecation. Harmless on device APKs.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:926-995 update_employee correctly implements partial-update semantics: uses `exclude_none=True` on model_dump so only supplied scalars are written; photo_b64 → data URL + face_encoding computed via _assess_enrolment; file:// → 422 before any DB touch; project_id transitions handled explicitly (any project_id!=None deletes prior allocations first, then either creates one new row + status=Active or empty→status='No Allocation'). Verified via all 9 pytest cases.
server.py:998-1017 delete_employee correctly clears AttendanceRecord + SalaryRecord + Allocation before deleting Employee — no orphans. Confirmed by the cascade pytest.

app/employees/[id].tsx:210,171-195 encodePhotoIfLocal correctly routes http(s):// and data: URIs through `photo` (no re-upload) and only reads file:// / other URIs through expo-image-manipulator base64 into `photo_b64`. Only triggers when `photoDirty === true`.
app/employees/[id].tsx:257-269 onSave error-parse pattern matches add.tsx: extracts JSON body from raw error text after the first '{' and surfaces `detail` as the toast message.

app/employees/index.tsx:208-217 EmpCard is a real Pressable with onPress → router.push('/employees/${emp.id}') AND still exposes testID=`employee-card-${emp.id}`. Verified live: tapping the first card lands on the Edit screen.
BUG (documented above): EmployeeOut drops ~14 columns → Edit screen renders empty inputs for gender/dob/father_name/aadhaar/current_address/etc. even when the DB has data.

success_rate.backend: 100% (39/39 pytest — 30 pre-existing + 9 new). All 6 review-request PATCH scenarios verified, plus the DELETE-with-children scenario.
success_rate.frontend: 100% for testable paths: all 10 required testIDs render on live /employees/<id>; card-tap navigation works end-to-end; Name/Code/Designation/Skill/Status/Project fields load real values. 1 HIGH bug: the other ~14 employee fields are blank because the backend read model omits them.

context_for_next_testing_agent: OTP bypass unchanged: seed a row via `pwdlib.PasswordHash.recommended().hash('123456')` on `otp_codes` for `techiearts19@gmail.com` then POST /api/auth/verify-otp with otp='123456'. To store the token for web-preview, use `localStorage.setItem('dihadi_access_token', JSON.stringify(token))` (nested JSON string) — the storage util wraps values in JSON.stringify. Live DB currently has 3 employees for the Saqib repro row set: DHD-2009 (id 39fba548...), DHD-1005 (id 6223238b...), QNS-1001 (id bb3c11e2...). The pytest suite takes ~4-5 min because it downloads a stock Unsplash face once per module and runs a real face encoding through dlib. After fixing the EmployeeOut/TS `Employee` schema, re-run just test_update_employee.py to keep the loop fast, but also re-run the frontend edit screen to visually confirm the previously-empty fields now populate.
rca_of_issue: USER FEATURE ADD: 'add employee edit section'. BACKEND: correctly implemented — PATCH /employees/{id} supports partial updates with photo_b64 face-quality-gate, file:// rejection, project (re)allocation via one Allocation row, and unallocation via empty project_id. DELETE now cascades AttendanceRecord/SalaryRecord/Allocation. All 9 backend tests pass and no regressions on the pre-existing 30. FRONTEND: The Edit screen is structurally correct — routing, testIDs, partial-update payload assembly, photo-dirty gating, and error-toast parse-from-JSON pattern all check out. However the screen suffers from an upstream data leak: GET /employees/{id} returns a slimmed-down EmployeeOut that omits the 14 extended-detail columns, so the form initialises blank for those fields. This is not a regression (the same schema existed before this iteration) but the Edit UX finally exposes it. Main agent should widen EmployeeOut + the TS `Employee` type in one change and the screen will just work.
